Title: SMC CDQ2B32-75DZ COMPACT CYLINDER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: CDQ2B32-75DZ
DESCRIPTION: C(D)Q2, Compact Cylinder, Double Acting, Single Rod w/Auto Switch Mounting Groove
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Magnet: D (Built-in) Mounting: B (Through Hole [Standard]) Type: Standard Bore Size: diameter 32 mm Port Thread Type: Rc Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 75 Body Option: Standard [Rod End Female Thread] Auto Switch Groove: Z [Auto Switch Mounting Grooves] Mounting Bolt: None Rod End Bracket: None Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5 m or None in the Case of No Switch Number: 2 pcs. Rod End Options: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Made of Stainless Steel: None Fluororubber Seal: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: Following a review of our popular CQ2 compact cylinder Series our R&D engineers have totally redesigned the complete cylinder range to bring you even more performance benefits and increased cylinder options. The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

DESCRIPTION: C(D)Q2, Compact Cylinder, Double Acting, Single Rod w/Auto Switch Mounting Groove
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Magnet: D (Built-in) Mounting: B (Through Hole [Standard]) Type: Standard Bore Size: diameter 63 mm Port Thread Type: Rc Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 75 Body Option: Standard [Rod End Female Thread] Auto Switch Groove: Z [Auto Switch Mounting Grooves] Mounting Bolt: None Rod End Bracket: None Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5 m or None in the Case of No Switch Number: 2 pcs. LONG DESCRIPTION: Following a review of our popular CQ2 compact cylinder Series our R&D engineers have totally redesigned the complete cylinder range to bring you even more performance benefits and increased cylinder options. The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

LONG DESCRIPTION: Following a review of our popular CQ2 compact cylinder Series our R&D engineers have totally redesigned the complete cylinder range to bring you even more performance benefits and increased cylinder options. The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.

LONG DESCRIPTION: We are pleased to unveil a new advanced flexible, heat and chemical resistant tubing that is chemically compatible with a wide range of fluids and can resist temperatures up to 260°C. The TLM features improved PFA material, which allows use in applications requiring chemical resistance and can withstand fluids that need to be conducted at very high temperatures. It also comes in four different colours – red, black, blue and translucent – so customers can set differently coloured tubes in a visual way to help ease the maintenance and calibration works process, which is required periodically. What is more, we have extended the size and length variations so customers can select exactly what they need in 13 metric and 9 inch options. It can also be ordered in seven different lengths from 2 metres straight up to 100 metre rolls. Developed to be combined with our extensive specific Fittings Series, the addition of the TLM tube provides customers with a complete solution for their piping equipment needs in one single step.
